name: Lumen Courier
lore: A lantern-bearing courier who delivers light to both sides of a battle: comfort for friends, a sharp warning for foes. Aim carefully; a friendly body can catch a healing dart before it reaches an enemy.

primary.name: Kindred Dart
primary.description: A non-piercing dart deals 16 damage to the first enemy or heals the first ally for 7 HP. Cannot hit its own caster.

secondary.name: Kindred Fan
secondary.description: Five darts fan out in an arc. Each deals 10 damage to an enemy or heals an ally for 4 HP. No piercing.

special.name: Lantern Relay
special.description: Place a 140-radius light for 3s. Friendly heroes gain 12% protection and heal 6 HP each second; includes the caster.

passive: Gentle Arrival: Allies struck by a healing dart gain 8% damage reduction for 0.8s.

technique.name: Patient Delivery

attack.name: Patient Delivery
attack.description: One slower dart: 20 enemy damage or 10 ally healing.

technique.description: Stronger dart, but cooldown rises from 0.75s to 1.1s.

final_technique.name: Clean Sanctuary

attack.name: Clean Sanctuary
attack.description: A 4s sanctuary grants 20% protection and removes poison/burn each second. No healing.

final_technique.description: Replace Relay healing with stronger protection and cleansing.
